about: Mutants of site/snippets, the snippet guard (WEBSITE unit 1). Each is killed by an Ergo test of the package, run at check time (scripts/ergotests).

mutants.name: shifted-mark-passes
mutants.rule: A mark's range holds the text it records, so an edit that moves or changes a marked span is caught.

mutants.name: cut-token-passes
mutants.rule: Neither end of a mark falls inside a token of the snippet's own scanner or tokens file.

mutants.name: mark-splitting-a-word-passes
mutants.from: for j < last && j < len(src) && isWord(src[j]) {
mutants.to: for j < i+1 && j < len(src) && isWord(src[j]) {
mutants.rule: In a merged highlighter record each run of word bytes is one token, so a mark that ends inside a word is caught.

mutants.name: records-kept-whole
mutants.rule: Only a string or comment record is one token; a merged record of another kind is split into its words, so a mark may start at the second word.

mutants.name: stale-tokens-pass
mutants.rule: A tokens file holds its snippet's digest: a snippet changed without regenerating its tokens fails.

mutants.name: checked-failing-check-passes
mutants.from:
if r.Status != 0 {
		return []string{"\(dir): ergo check exits
mutants.to:
if r.Status > 1 {
		return []string{"\(dir): ergo check exits
mutants.rule: A checked snippet whose ergo check fails is reported.

mutants.name: checked-diagnostic-passes
mutants.rule: A checked snippet with any diagnostic, even one that exits 0, is reported.

mutants.name: landed-planned-unreported
mutants.rule: A planned snippet that now checks is reported, so its next badge comes off when the feature lands.

mutants.name: unlisted-planned-passes
mutants.rule: Every planned snippet has its manifest row: the badge is drawn from the manifest alone.

mutants.name: ratio-over-one-shown
mutants.rule: A shown number is at or under 1.0 against its control; over 1.0 is a bug, never a page.

mutants.name: control-unnamed-passes
mutants.rule: A shown number names its control.

mutants.name: mislabelled-control-passes
mutants.rule: A ratio measured against ordinary hand Go is never labelled the floor.

mutants.name: guard-skips-checked
mutants.rule: The guard judges ergo check of every checked package.

mutants.name: guard-skips-planned
mutants.rule: The guard judges ergo check --want of every planned snippet.

mutants.name: guard-skips-missing-tokens
mutants.rule: Every TypeScript and Go snippet has its tokens file.
